# MixAuto package map (one line each — open topic rule / skill before deep reads)

Root guide: AGENTS.md | Verify: .\scripts\verify-debug.ps1 (see mix-auto-build-release.mdc)
OpenCode cold start: skill local-opencode-loop first; map bugs → local-map-triage; map features → local-map-feature; short prompts OK — no ask-loops
Commands: /map-bug <symptom> (build) | /map-plan <symptom> (plan only)
Map triage (bugs): .opencode/skills/local-map-triage | Map feature (implement): .opencode/skills/local-map-feature | OpenCode loop: .opencode/skills/local-opencode-loop | GitHub release (not debug): .opencode/skills/local-apk | Debug verify: .\scripts\verify-debug.ps1

## Packages

MainActivity.kt — entry; permissions; wires MapHostViewModel → DashboardScreen
domain/map/ — CarMapEngine port, MapUiState, SearchResultPlace (thin contracts)
domain/media/ — MediaPlaybackState
data/map/ — MapLibre facade + GPS/puck/camera/style/route/POI collaborators (mix-auto-map-engine.mdc)
data/navigation/ — turn-by-turn TTS, step phrases (mix-auto-navigation.mdc)
data/places/ — offline Overture POI SQLite + encountered places (mix-auto-places.mdc)
data/media/ — MediaSessionRepository, album art, audio resume (mix-auto-media.mdc)
data/location/ — Nominatim reverse geocode helpers
data/apps/ — launchable apps for drawer/dock
data/update/ — app update checks
data/weather/ — weather fetch (if used by HUD/settings)
ui/map/ — MapHostViewModel (activity-scoped engine holder; keep thin)
ui/dashboard/ — DashboardScreen, MediaPlayerPane, dock layouts (mix-auto-dashboard-ui.mdc)
ui/components/ — map container, search, POI drawer, settings panels, overlays
ui/settings/ — LauncherViewModel, preferences, MapDataViewModel
ui/theme/ — Color, CarDimensions, Type, MixAutoTheme
ui/onboarding/ — first-run permission wizard
ui/status/ — status bar pieces
ui/media/ — media ViewModel helpers
service/ — notification listener, offline map download service

## data/map owners (do not grow MapLibreEngineImpl)

MapLibreEngineImpl.kt — facade / wiring only (~1.3k; prefer collaborators); still owns NAV_TILT_OFFSET companion (live)
RouteModels.kt — LegStep, RouteResult, route layer/progress constants
PoiOverlayCoordinator.kt — POI cache, mix overlay refresh, preview layers, native poi_* visibility
RouteOverviewController.kt — route overview bounds/hold timer, then nav camera dive
DestinationSearchCoordinator.kt — destination search merge (local/cache/Photon)
SearchOriginResolver.kt — search origin resolution (GPS / map center / PH fallback)
PhotonSearchClient.kt — Photon HTTP fetch for destination + nearby POI
PoiQueryCoordinator.kt — POI cache search, tile query, nearby merge, viewport seed
LighterTrafficHelper.kt — TomTom alternate scoring / route conversion (pure)
MapInteractionController.kt — map tap/long-press, custom pin draft, reverse geocode
NavigationSessionCoordinator.kt — navigate, startNavigation, reroute, lighter-traffic alternate
OfflineRegionCatalog.kt — offline_regions.json catalog load
OfflineRegionMetadata.kt — offline region SDK metadata parse / resumability
SmoothingLocationEngine.kt — puck blend + extrapolation
LocationTrackingController.kt — GPS tick, road-snap display, padding push
NavigationCameraController.kt — free-drive / nav dive / cameraSessionId / zoomWhileTracking apply
NavigationZoom.kt — maneuver-distance follow zoom math (pure); extend here for new zoom formulas + tests
PoiOverlayRenderer.kt — mix POI icon/text layers, native poi_* visibility; mix poiTextOnly* = VIEWPORT (detached pan only — hidden while navigating)
MapStyleController.kt — style load, traffic, 3D buildings, road boost; nav label stretch → style text-pitch-alignment / mix-auto-driving.json (not mix-poi-label MAP flip)
RouteRenderer.kt — route GeoJSON greying (not puck motion)
OffRouteDetector.kt — parallel-street off-route confirms
ConventionalRouteSelector.kt / NavigationRouteFetcher.kt — OSRM conventional + fetch
OfflineMapRepository.kt — offline tile download/observe (catalog + metadata extracted)

## Agent habits

- Load one topic rule or skill per task (OpenCode: open .mdc by path; globs may not auto-load)
- Files >~400 lines: grep / signature skim first; full-read only the edit target
- New collaborators: prefer <~400 lines; extract on clear second responsibility — no hard 150-line rewrite of existing debt
- Explicit return types on new public/internal APIs; no mass-annotate private helpers
- Never claim success without BUILD SUCCESSFUL or MIXAUTO_VERIFY_DONE exit=0
- Gradle done = done: BUILD SUCCESSFUL / BUILD FAILED / MIXAUTO_VERIFY_DONE in stream/metadata OR repo-root MIXAUTO_VERIFY_DONE.txt means finished even if bash UI still shows Running — do not re-run
- Verify command: .\scripts\verify-debug.ps1 alone (no cd, no &&); stamp file is gitignored
- mix-auto-driving.json is one minified JSON line (not binary) — rewrite with Python for text-pitch-alignment; no *.backup
- MapLibre tilt: 0° = overhead; higher = more pitched; overhead request → decrease tilt or NAV_TILT_OFFSET; more nav pitch → increase NAV_TILT_OFFSET; report nav = freeDriveTilt + NAV_TILT_OFFSET (not free-drive alone)
